title: Special Anna, don't let her get away!
text:
Anna is very talented, sweet, and highly prepared! 
She made us passionate and opened us up to the world of Seville!! Highly recommended !!!
author: NicolaEma

title: Great experience
text: An empathetic girl but above all very knowledgeable, it was a very pleasant day!
author: sandraFritta

title: Great experience
text: Anna is a knowledgeable guide, very empathetic, and with her stories she makes you enter the atmosphere of this splendid city that is Seville!
author: LilianaL752

title: An unforgettable tour in Seville thanks to the wonderful Anna!
text: We had a beautiful experience in Seville thanks to Anna! She was a fantastic guide: knowledgeable, kind, helpful, and very engaging. She accompanied us on a discovery of the city, telling us many interesting facts and making us appreciate its history, its beauty, and its most characteristic corners even more. You can really tell that she loves what she does and manages to convey all of her passion. She was truly excellent and made our tour special and pleasant. Highly recommended! Thank you from the heart, Anna! ❤️
author: Q3520MLstefanof

title: A wonderful Seville with Anna
text: Anna took us for a walk through a stunning Seville, telling us with passion about the origins, history, and changes of this city. There was no shortage of anecdotes and curiosities; Anna puts real passion into her work and manages to convey it to the group she leads.
author: Silvietta23091986

title: Seville: Tapas Tour - October 2026
text:
Anna is a true guarantee: punctuality, seriousness, professionalism, and so, so much availability and friendliness.
A super guide, highly recommended...
author: X8147RQfabios

title: Great job, Anna!
text:
We relied on Anna's expert guidance during the two days we spent in Seville. Her expertise, clear language, and historical knowledge—not only of the city but also of all of Spain—allowed us to appreciate Seville in its entirety and also prepare for the subsequent stages of our trip in Andalusia, which then touched on the cities of Cordoba, Granada, and Malaga.
 Highly recommended!
author: Daydream48411322513

title: 6 hours flown by with Anna
text:
Combining historical information with local color, he made us know and understand Seville.
The friendliness made such a truly professional service so enjoyable that the time flew by.
Highly recommended
author: ilmaxpapa

title: TOP GUIDE
text: Anna was truly the BEST. Available and very attentive to details. Having 4 children in tow, she made sure to involve them in the city tour so as not to tire them out (let's consider the fact that we chose the 5-hour tour ourselves). I HIGHLY recommend Anna as a guide.
author: alberto_vomiero

title: Great job, Anna!
text:
We participated in a guided tour of about three hours in Seville with Anna, visiting the Santa Cruz neighborhood and the Alcázar, and we can sincerely say that it was one of the most pleasant experiences of our trip.

We were two families, with two adults and two children (12 and 7 years old) each, and Anna succeeded in something that is not at all a given: making the visit engaging and interesting for both the adults and the children. She knew how to tell the story of Seville in a simple, clear, and never boring way, enriching the tour with many curious and fun anecdotes that captured everyon
author: E9075EAlisaf
